newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Bisichi says Sowits claims unfounded.
newsitem.headline: Bisichi says Sowits claims unfounded.

text.p: Bisichi Mining plc said on Monday the main purpose of a proposed rights issue by Southern Witwatersrand Exploration Co Ltd (Sowits) seemed to be to raise funds to bring legal action against Bishichi and others.
The action would be to try to regain control of Black Wattle Colliery, Bisichi said in a paid announcement.
It said it had been advised by its lawyers that the claims by Sowits were totally unfounded and would be vigorously defended.

Bisichi, which has already subscribed to the recent Black Wattle rights issue to the extent of 1.4 million rand, would not have done so if it had any doubts as to its continuing legal owership of its shares in and control of Black Wattle, it said.
Bisichi said an application brought by Sowits against Black Wattle in October to prevent the rights issue did not succeed.
Sowits' listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange was suspended on November 22 pending clarification on certain aspects disclosed in the company's rights offer circular issued on November 8.
The exchange gave no further details.
